title: UX-01 task 1: reference fixture of real Hyperia City printings
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: The Director approved the full UX-01 design for end-to-end completion. Implementation-plan task 1: packages/rules-data/fixtures/reference-selection.json selects 69 real Hyperia City (set 14) printings from the 2026-10-21 acquisition, each with its own reason: the player's Amber/Steel deck and the opponent's Emerald/Sapphire deck (60 cards each) with every card's role in the crowded match, two binder spreads (Amber 1–18/204 and Sapphire 137–154/204), a 12-card demonstration pack drawn from the spreads, and four special printings. Six printings inspected in the stories are flagged for full-card images.

scripts/catalog-lib.mjs fixtureImageSources takes details 'all' (presentation fixture, unchanged) or 'flagged' (reference fixture); scripts/select-fixtures.mjs writes both fixtures and reuses an image either manifest already records when its checksum matches; scripts/verify-fixtures.mjs proves both committed fixtures equal what their selections derive from the recorded snapshot. src/fixtures.ts exports referenceCatalog, referenceSelection, referenceImages, referencePrinting and referenceImage through the same normalizer as the presentation fixture. The generated src/fixtures/reference.json and reference-images.json and 74 new image files (68 thumbnails and 6 full-card images; Port Authority's thumbnail was already recorded) were written by select-fixtures, which fetched them from Ravensburger's public image host at 2026-10-22T14:01Z. The presentation fixture and its manifests are byte-identical.

tests/catalog.test.mjs adds three tests, written first: the reference selection reproduced in order with no duplicate printing or reason; every reference printing's rotation state is CoreConstructed; a thumbnail for every printing, full-card images only where flagged, thumbnails within 4 MB and full-card images within 3 MB. The existing image test now covers both manifests and refuses any unrecorded file. RUN-20261022-006 records the expected failure before the exports existed; RUN-20261022-007 passes 12 tests.

Card-catalog runbook (fixture use and rebuild for both fixtures), card-catalog validation (dated reference-fixture section with counts, bytes, checks and receipts), the rules-data README, the F-CARD-CATALOG feature row and the handoff.
